title: ID0415916-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002834] Unlocking only works after several attempts
description:
Reported issue: Unlocking only works after several attempts - Volvo BCB toggle
Solution: Use OCPP connection with EcoG 1.4.11 or ask customers to click the button next to the CCS

additional_info.subject: ID0415916-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002834] Unlocking only works after several attempts CRM:02678000038
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph,
Thanks for sharing your concerns.
Let's separate the 2 different EVs since there are 2 topics with both of them.
For Volvo is really simple, the
Volvo trucks
have a functionality called “
wake-up function
", what this does is, whenever you stop a charging session from anywhere
except
the HMI of the charger, the EV will reattempt to start a session if he wants to, without any human interaction.
So imagine, you are charging your Volvo and it reaches 100%, the Volvo itself will stop the session saying, "I'm full", but let's imagine that you as a depot, want to leave the truck charging overnight and have it full by morning. Usually, the truck is still using some small amount of kW to maintain the auxiliary systems like air conditioning or lights.
When the Volvo truck sees that it's 99% (for example, I don't know the exact automation), it will say again, please let's start charging if possible. Here is what we see from the logs
What you see here is an infinite loop of the EV asking to restart the session. This is what I think the customer means with unlocking worked after several attempts.
If you don't stop from the HMI, the EV will always reattempt to start again.
Since the EV is constantly changing PilotStates, it won't let the plug out happen, we need to have it on permanent “B1” state which is when you can plug out, but since he is toggling, it won't let you plug out. In another customer, we found that the Volvos have a release button next to the CCS plug.
For this particular case, there are two solutions:
Implement an OCPP connection
We have a hotfix that can enable the wake-up function in the latest version but it's mandatory to have OCPP connection.
Truck driver stop the session via HMI
Truck driver press the button next to the CCS plug after it finishes charging and it's stuck.
For the IVECO, it's a different issue, I already explained to you in the ticket ID0415899. There is no fix from firmware side since IVECO themselves have reported to have a very sensitive system and can cause the failed sessions to rarely occur.
I already sent them the communication regarding this failures from all your chargers in the depot as we already made a thorough analysis. They requested some extra information from my side which I already shared.
For now, the only solution for the IVECO trucks is to simply retry the session until it works, I see from the logs sometimes it takes just one more try, sometimes it takes 2 or 3.
What I suggest sharing with the customer is in summary:
Volvo drivers:
Stop the session via HMI
When it's stuck press the button next to the CCS plug to unlock.
IVECO drivers:
Reattempt the session until it works
Let me know if this was the information you required.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
